title: Jacob Flees from Laban

questions.question: What did Rachel steal from her father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:19: Rachel stole the household gods.

questions.question: Did Jacob tell Laban he was leaving?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:20: Jacob fled without telling Laban.

questions.question: Who warned Laban not to harm Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:24: God warned Laban in a dream.

questions.question: Did Laban find the stolen household gods?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:34-35: Rachel hid them and Laban didn't find them.

questions.question: Did Jacob and Laban make peace?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:44: They made a covenant together.

questions.question: How long had Jacob worked for Laban?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:41: Jacob served 20 years in Laban's house.

questions.question: Where did Rachel hide the household gods?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:34: Rachel put them in the camel's saddle and sat on them.

questions.question: What did Jacob set up as a witness of the covenant?
options: A pillar and heap of stones
questions.correctAnswer: A pillar and heap of stones
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:45-46: Jacob set up a pillar and they made a heap.

questions.question: What name did Laban give the heap?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:47: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha (in Aramaic).

questions.question: What name did Jacob give the heap?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:47: Jacob called it Galeed (in Hebrew).

questions.question: How many times did Laban change Jacob's wages?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:7: "your father has cheated me and changed my wages ten times."

questions.question: What was also called Mizpah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:49: The heap was also called Mizpah.

questions.question: What did the Mizpah blessing mean?
options: The LORD watch between you and me
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD watch between you and me
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:49: "The LORD watch between you and me, when we are out of one another's sight."

questions.question: What penalty did Jacob unknowingly pronounce on Rachel?
options: Death for whoever stole the gods
questions.correctAnswer: Death for whoever stole the gods
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:32: "Anyone with whom you find your gods shall not live."

questions.question: How many days did it take Laban to catch up to Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 31:23: Laban pursued Jacob for seven days.

key_verse_text: 'The Lord watch between you and me, when we are out of one another's sight.'
